+---

+title: 'GraphQLViewer.startedSessions: the sessions this viewer''s connection started'
+---
+For ACPA-13 and D120 (TestudoApp 9311882). Under the EXTRAS-9 visibility rule an external viewer sees the sessions it started, even when a user device has since taken them over and they are no longer in `ownedSessions`.
+
+- [ ] Add `public var startedSessions: Set<String>` to GraphQLViewer, defaulting to `[]`, documented like the other fields
+- [ ] Add an init parameter `startedSessions: Set<String> = []`
+- [ ] Decoding uses decodeIfPresent, so a payload with no key gives `[]`
+- [ ] Tests: the default is empty, a round trip keeps the value, and the old shape decodes to `[]`
+- [ ] Add a line to EXTRAS-5 in TestudoApp features/packages/foundationmodels-extras.md
+
+#graphql
